newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: IPCL says won't extend offer for W&H shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPCL says won't extend offer for W&H shrs.

text.p: Independent Press Communications, the bidding vehicle for Independent Newspapers Plc in its takeover of Wilson and Horton, said on Monday its offer for the New Zealand publisher would definitely close on Friday, November 15.
IPCL also said it would instruct its broker to withdraw its separate stand-in-the-market offer on or before Friday.
Last week, IPCL extended by one week its offer of NZ$11 or 1.375 exchangeable INP shares for each Wilson and Horton share.

"I am very keen to make it absolutely clear to remaining Wilson and Horton shareholders that we will not be extending our written offer, and that we will not be increasing it," IPCL chairman Michael Walls said in a statement.
"Furthermore, we will also be instructing our brokers to withdraw the stand-in-the-market offer later this week."
The combined shareholding of IPCL and the three Independent Press companies in Wilson and Horton had increased to more than 79 percent.
